status: Source and local tests only; no transactions authorized or executed. This is not launch.json.

windowPolicy.start: Native start refreshed by delivery, commitment, retry, renewal or top-up; commitment requires Delivered
windowPolicy.ready: nativeHead >= start + 8; active Delivered/None job, committed candidate, unspent reserve within deadline; SDK/UI additionally require an available positive live quote <= reserve
windowPolicy.reserveDeadline: max(existing, now + 1 day) on delivery/commit/renew/top-up; renewal only after expiry; top-up allowed before or after expiry
windowPolicy.constructor: Reads minimumWindowAgeBlocks() from the already-deployed pinned codec; unsupported chains revert
windowPolicy.preflight: Compare codec minimum with independent tooling policy and reject any configured age below it; this validates assumptions, not live cadence
windowPolicy.topUp: Requester only; Delivered/None, committed, uncancelled, current ask intakeId == 0; positive original-asset exact pull; total reserve <= maxPriceOf(original job asset); ask/job/candidate unchanged

contracts.signerPolicy: Signer address and epoch recorded at trigger. Ordinary rotation preserves pending answers; explicit epoch revocation blocks pending and finalized verdicts.
contracts.capPolicy: Token base units: constructor/setProtocol write only maxPriceOf(selected asset). maxPrice() returns maxPriceOf(asset()). Other token caps persist across rotation; same-token reductions affect new funding/retries, never an already-funded trigger. SDK/UI top-up reads the reserve token cap without fallback.

inputs.$owner: Actual launch owner supplied by the deployment operator; never factory/msg.sender or a guessed address.
inputs.$intake: Verified Intake v2 on the selected chain, from the supplied protocol reference and current capability/code checks.
inputs.$asset: That chain's existing IMD asset, from the protocol reference; never mint or replace it.
inputs.$oracleSigner: The existing IdentityMD v2 oracle signer/trust root from the reference; no new signer.
inputs.$poolManager: Chain-specific manager from the unchanged GatedHookDeployer pinned policy.
inputs.$verifiedManagerCodeHash: Read code and match the unchanged production pin before owner activation.

responsibilities: Infrastructure setup only; no per-hook owner binding call.
Check runtime sizes, codec code hash, protocol quotes, owner handoff and enabled manager before admitting user fees.

Ethereum and Robinhood sell both actions in the captured capabilities. Sepolia is oracle-only; Base has no supported Intake. Never guess support.

Read back per-token caps after every protocol rotation; configure a legacy-token cap by deliberately selecting that token with setProtocol. Retain its original Intake/action quotes for existing jobs.
